title: 40-meter metallic object in the labyrinth
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 40-meter metallic object in the labyrinth, about present at Egypt (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a 40 meter object that's in that labyrinth that's in some vast corridor that's metallic. It's a UFO.
The 40 meter metallic object that's shaped like a tic tac
tellings.difference: Told second hand from Ben van Kerkwyk, citing a scan report, and adds that the object is shaped like a tic tac.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the same 40-meter metallic object inside the Egyptian underground labyrinth.

as_told.title: 40-meter tic tac metallic object in Egyptian labyrinth

tellings.quote: That's in the labyrinth that Herodotus and Pliny the Elder and Ben Van Kerkwijk is now sort of reporting on.
tellings.difference: Cites Herodotus and Pliny the Elder as ancient sources for the labyrinth, and does not give the object's size.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the metallic object said to lie in the Egyptian labyrinth, which Van Kerkwijk reports on.

as_told.title: Egyptian labyrinth and metallic object reported in it
